problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is tasked with allocating a series of shipments onto identical transport vessels. The cargo manifests are as follows:
* Cargo Alpha: mass 50 tonnes
* Cargo Beta: mass 42 tonnes
* Cargo Gamma: mass 70 tonnes
* Cargo Delta: mass 37 tonnes
* Cargo Epsilon: mass 69 tonnes
* Cargo Zeta: mass 45 tonnes
* Cargo Eta: mass 52 tonnes
* Cargo Theta: mass 55 tonnes
* Cargo Iota: mass 36 tonnes
* Cargo Kappa: mass 47 tonnes
* Cargo Lambda: mass 54 tonnes
* Cargo Mu: mass 65 tonnes
* Cargo Nu: mass 52 tonnes
* Cargo Xi: mass 32 tonnes
* Cargo Omicron: mass 70 tonnes
* Cargo Pi: mass 51 tonnes
* Cargo Rho: mass 44 tonnes
* Cargo Sigma: mass 55 tonnes
* Cargo Tau: mass 32 tonnes
* Cargo Upsilon: mass 56 tonnes
* Cargo Phi: mass 64 tonnes
* Cargo Chi: mass 47 tonnes
* Cargo Psi: mass 40 tonnes
* Cargo Omega: mass 46 tonnes
* Cargo Digamma: mass 32 tonnes
* Cargo Stigma: mass 47 tonnes
* Cargo Heta: mass 35 tonnes
* Cargo San: mass 51 tonnes
* Cargo Koppa: mass 56 tonnes

Each transport vessel possesses a maximum capacity of 100 tonnes. The coordinator must assign all shipments, each to precisely one vessel, ensuring the aggregated mass on any given vessel does not surpass its stipulated limit. The objective is to utilize the minimal possible number of vessels to complete the allocation.
